sdk_receipt_lane.deduplication: Per-record receipt_id; take max per ID before sum within1h; exclude old records with no ID. Replaying must retain the same ID.

sdk_receipt_lane.delivery: Atomic private0600 complete files; UUID first in payload protects distinct-file fingerprints. Receiver offsets persisted and downstream refusals retried; native Loki exporter has a bounded persistent queue.
sdk_receipt_lane.privacy: Future helper omits items/final_response/raw errors; earlier raw seed receipts remain private migration inputs. Corrected Loki records contained only allowed metadata and omitted bodies.
sdk_receipt_lane.automation_acceptance: Offline identity, unknown-usage, no-overwrite and query guards plus actual receiver ingestion; modified helper was not followed by another model-inference run.
sdk_receipt_lane.limits: Retained spool has no automatic expiry. No loss/recovery acceptance under full disk or extended backend outage. Same-ID replay grouping is not general exactly-once accounting.
sdk_receipt_lane.invalid_input: Native parser on_error=drop_quiet excludes malformed JSON without content-bearing diagnostics; private source retained. Source/configuration check, not malformed-input acceptance.
